name: memory
title_zh: 会先问你要不要存档的会话记忆管家
tagline_zh: 跨会话续写项目，不用翻旧聊天记录。它只存你点头的证据、教训和决定，还能按指令忘掉，像给 AI 配了个记事本。
tagline_en: Pick up where you left off without scrolling old chats. Saves only what you approve—lessons, decisions.
desc_en: Recall earlier project work, save evidence-backed lessons or decisions, consolidate session records, or forget stored notes using Codex Mem. Use for work that depends on previous sessions or an explicit memory request.
why_zh: 记忆不该是黑箱。它把「记住」拆成显式动作：先问、再存、可删，让 AI 的长期记忆可控可审计，不悄悄长毛。
why_en: Memory shouldn't be a black box. It turns 'remember' into explicit steps: ask, store, delete—so AI's long-term memory stays.
limit_zh: 只认 Codex CLI 环境，且依赖用户主动触发；不会自动从对话中抓取隐含记忆，也不支持跨设备同步。
limit_en: Requires Codex CLI; relies on explicit user triggers; no auto-capture of implicit context; no cross-device sync.
title_en: Session memory keeper that asks before saving
